title: Allow setting the image opacity on dragging

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body: ### What problem are you trying to solve? When implementing drag-n-drop, having a visual feedback helps the user have a better understanding of their action. Which is why the method `setDragImage` of a `DataTransfer` instance exists. The spec says that this method takes three parameters: the "image" to show, and the `x` and `y` coordinates relative to the dragged element where the image should be shown. The "image" can be a real `` element in which case the element's image will be taken into the drag data store bitmap, or any other element in which case an image will be generated through currently unspecified means. The issue is that nowhere can we set the opacity of the image shown, and browsers often set some arbitrary opacity, which may be impractical in some cases. If a completely opaque image is needed, there is currently no way of assigning it to the `DataTransfer` instance. I believe custom *dnd* implementations (as well as some JS libraries) might benefit from using this option. ### What solutions exist today? Currently, the only way I know of to implement custom opacity on a dragged image is to implement the "dragged image" functionality in JS. We have to create an element and update it's position after every mouse move (or every animation frame) which has a performance cost and may feel less responsive (visual feedback may be a frame or two late, compared to the `DataTransfer` image which feels instant). ### How would you solve it? I see two ways of implementing that in the API: - add a fourth optional parameter for the opacity (number from 0 to 1) like this `.setDataImage(img, x, y, opacity)` - add a method `.setDataImageOpacity(opacity)` (with opacity from 0 to 1) The first method would be shorter and feel cleaner. The second method would allow setting the opacity for the default image chosen by the browser. For both methods, a new property would need to be stored in the drag data store. ### Anything else? _No response_
